g.text: Policy-controlled contribution suppression · one recorded source
Post-hoc 60 s prefix · 90,619 observation contributions · same taxonomy and regional hard constraints
Full-input distortion = (all omitted contributions + retained taxonomy cost) / original input.
Adaptive methods may use 4 s; fixed comparator chooses 1 s. This is a limited portfolio, not the best fixed schedule.
Declared utility/support measures; no measured privacy gain or real-time guarantee. Source prefix SHA-256: 3f069cc969b4
